findings.message:
[P3] Added relay-parent tests duplicate existing runGroups coverage

Both added tests call `runGroups` with a stub and assert per-file `uos-live-run-*` cleanup; the tests immediately below already cover the same nonzero-exit and thrown-execution paths (lines 121-166), and neither new test exercises `main`'s call to `runGroups`. As a result the duplicate tests add no guard against the #1176 failure scenario where a later refactor makes `main` call `runFile` directly; remove them or target the real `main` loop instead.

tests/live-network-policy.test.ts:79-84

summary: The candidate adds a durable owner-only checklist and two relay-parent tests. The tests duplicate existing runGroups coverage and do not exercise main's call, so they add no new guard against the issue's failure scenario; no functional breakage was found, and the base already contains the substantive fixes for all four task items.

evidence: Base README line 24 already states the Linux relay serves only the run's key-holding forwarder, and line 26 lists setns and ptrace host-process limits, satisfying item 3.
Base docs/DECISIONS.md lines 221-226 and docs/log-retention-and-quota-runway-2026-08-25.md lines 181-183 already track both owner-only items as pending under #1176, satisfying item 1.
Base tests/live-network-policy.test.ts lines 79-124 already test runGroups per-file uos-live-run parent cleanup after a nonzero exit and a thrown execution, satisfying item 2's exported-loop test.

Base docs/handoff/gateway-terminal-truthfulness-handoff-2026-09-21.md lines 35-50 already point to the corrected heading CORRECTION: the narration symptom counts are unverified - 2026-09-21, satisfying item 4.
